title: dispatch's return lists the docs selfdoc stale names on the worker's branch, so a missing Self-Reviewed goes back before the landing
goal: when a dispatched worker exits, dispatch runs selfdoc.py stale --since the upstream main in the worker's worktree and prints each stale doc, so a worker that reported stale=0 while its branch leaves a doc stale is sent back before land stops at its stale step

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print('check failed:', e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import os, re, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
T = tempfile.mkdtemp()
B = os.path.join(T, 'bin'); os.mkdir(B)
open(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 'w').write('#!/bin/sh\nexit 1\n')
os.chmod(os.path.join(B, 'claude'), 0o755)
ENV = dict(os.environ, PATH=B + os.pathsep + os.environ['PATH'])
def bench(*a):
    return subprocess.run([sys.executable, '_tools/benchmarks.py', *a], capture_output=True, text=True, env=ENV, timeout=1800)
s = open('_tools/bl_dispatch.py', encoding='utf-8').read()
i = s.index('def cmd_dispatch'); body = s[i:s.index('\ndef ', i + 1)]
assert 'stale' in body, 'cmd_dispatch reads no stale docs on the worker branch when the worker exits'

notes: SP-7s6uubs7 close: ST-ggsixlo3's worker reported stale=0, then land stopped at step stale on kb/_self/code.md (its three sibling workers had named it in Self-Reviewed). The check reads source only: planning replaces it with a planted worker branch.
